$Comment: Harvest Moon nights lift Harvesting and Artillery XP for everyone, on a server running MMO Skill
Tree. Only that mod reads this folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A boost rule is a standing boost: nobody activates it and it has no timer. It applies to every XP
award in the skills it names while its Requires passes, and it counts as a global boost, so the
server's stack mode and multiplier cap in skill-config.json bound it like any other.
Skills takes skill ids, a category (GATHERING, COMBAT, CRAFTING, MISC) or all, the words
/mmoboost takes. Multiplier is the factor applied to the XP: 1.25 is a quarter more.
ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live reads 1 only while that calendar event runs, so this rule needs both
Hallow's Eve and its Harvest Moon running. Text.TitleKey names it on the boosts pages; its words
are in hallowseve.mmo.lang. To change or switch it off, ship a file with this same name in a pack
of your own that loads after this one.
